feature: Gemini button, suggested replies & AI message summaries
summary: The Gemini button, smart replies and AI notification summaries each have their own toggle — but they live in three different menus, so most people only ever find one.

steps.path: Messages → profile icon → Messages settings → Gemini in Messages → toggle off "Show Gemini button"
Messages settings → Chats → Suggestions & smart replies → off (also kills AI sticker suggestions)
Messages settings → Notifications → AI message summaries → off

collateral: smart reply chips and sticker suggestions go away
whyTheyDidIt: Messaging is the highest-frequency app on the phone — the cheapest place to build a Gemini habit.

sources.label: Yahoo Tech — how to disable Gemini in Google Messages
Kaspersky — suggested replies and AI message summaries

alternatives.name: Signal
alternatives.why: no assistant, no summaries, no suggestions
